📘 Class 9 English — Beehive — Chapter 7: Reach for the Top — Explanation & Worksheet
Prepared by O.P. Verma Sir
🌟 Reach for the Top — Chapter 7

Central Idea: This chapter presents two inspiring biographical pieces: Santosh Yadav, the Indian mountaineer, and Maria Sharapova, the tennis champion. Both stories highlight determination, discipline, hard work, courage and perseverance. The chapter is built around the idea that difficult circumstances need not stop a person from pursuing a goal.

Part-1 — Santosh Yadav

English Explanation: Santosh Yadav was born in Haryana and questioned restrictive social customs from an early age. She insisted on continuing her education and later developed an interest in mountaineering. She trained at the Nehru Institute of Mountaineering, Uttarkashi. Her determination and physical and mental preparation led to her Everest achievements; she became the first woman to scale Mount Everest twice.

हिन्दी में संक्षिप्त समझ: संतोष यादव ने बचपन से ही रूढ़ सामाजिक परंपराओं को चुनौती दी। उन्होंने शिक्षा जारी रखने के लिए दृढ़ता दिखाई और बाद में पर्वतारोहण की ओर आकर्षित हुईं। उन्होंने उत्तरकाशी के नेहरू इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ माउंटेनियरिंग में प्रशिक्षण लिया। लगातार अभ्यास, साहस और दृढ़ निश्चय के कारण उन्होंने एवरेस्ट की चढ़ाई की और दो बार एवरेस्ट पर पहुँचने वाली पहली महिला बनीं।

📝 Part-1 Worksheet — Santosh Yadav
  1. Where did Santosh receive mountaineering training? — Nehru Institute of Mountaineering, Uttarkashi.
  2. What quality helped Santosh challenge social customs? — Determination and independence.
  3. What is Santosh's major Everest achievement? — She became the first woman to scale Mount Everest twice.
Part-2 — Maria Sharapova

English Explanation: Maria Sharapova's story describes her journey from Siberia to international tennis. As a young girl she moved to the United States for training, faced separation from her family and accepted demanding discipline. Her success came through focused training, competitive spirit, mental strength and sustained hard work.

हिन्दी में संक्षिप्त समझ: मारिया शारापोवा साइबेरिया से निकलीं और कम उम्र में टेनिस प्रशिक्षण के लिए अमेरिका गईं। परिवार से दूर रहना और कठिन प्रशिक्षण उनके लिए चुनौतीपूर्ण था, लेकिन उन्होंने लक्ष्य पर ध्यान बनाए रखा। उनकी कहानी मेहनत, अनुशासन, मानसिक मजबूती और लक्ष्य के प्रति समर्पण को रेखांकित करती है।

📝 Part-2 Worksheet — Maria Sharapova
  1. Where was Maria Sharapova born? — Siberia, Russia.
  2. Why did Maria go to the United States? — For advanced tennis training.
📝 Part-1 और Part-2 दोनों का Worksheet
  1. Who are the two achievers presented in the chapter? — Santosh Yadav and Maria Sharapova.
  2. Write two common qualities of Santosh and Maria. — Hard work and determination.
  3. What is the main message of the chapter? — Persistent effort, discipline and courage help a person pursue ambitious goals.
  4. Use perseverance in a sentence. — Perseverance helps us continue even when a task is difficult.
  5. Write a short paragraph: “My goal and how I will work for it.”
📗 Class 9 English Grammar — Ch-1 Determiners + Ch-2 Prepositions
Prepared by O.P. Verma Sir
🔴 Ch-1 Determiners

Determiners are words placed before nouns to make their meaning clear or specific. Common determiners include a, an, the, this, that, these, those, some, any, much, many, few, little, my, your, each, every.

Important Rules
  • a is generally used before a singular countable noun beginning with a consonant sound: a book.
  • an is generally used before a singular countable noun beginning with a vowel sound: an apple.
  • the is used when the noun is specific or already known: the sun.
  • many/few are used with countable nouns; much/little are used with uncountable nouns.
  • each/every generally take a singular countable noun: Every student is ready.
Worksheet — Determiners
  1. Fill in: I saw ___ elephant. — an
  2. Fill in: She has ___ blue pen. — a
  3. Fill in: ___ sun rises in the east. — The
  4. Choose: There are ___ books on the table. — many
  5. Choose: There isn't ___ milk left. — much
  6. Fill in: ___ student must submit the work. — Every
  7. Choose: I have ___ friends in Jaipur. — some
  8. Correct the sentence: He bought an uniform. — He bought a uniform.
🔵 Ch-2 Prepositions

Prepositions show relationships of place, time, direction, movement or position. Common examples are in, on, at, under, over, between, among, from, to, into, across, beside, behind.

Important Rules
  • in is commonly used for months, years, long periods and enclosed places: in July, in 2026, in the room.
  • on is commonly used with days and dates: on Monday, on 29 September.
  • at is commonly used for a specific time or point: at 5 o'clock, at the station.
  • between is normally used for two people/things; among is used for more than two.
  • into shows movement from outside to inside; in generally shows position.
Worksheet — Prepositions
  1. The book is ___ the table. — on
  2. We live ___ India. — in
  3. The class starts ___ 8 a.m. — at
  4. She came ___ Monday. — on
  5. The cat is ___ the chair. — under
  6. The teacher stood ___ the two students. — between
  7. He walked ___ the room. — into
  8. The school is ___ the bank and the post office. — between
🗣️ Class 6 English — Oral Test (Half Yearly 2026-27) with Answers
MOTHER TERESA CHILDREN SECONDARY SCHOOL VIGYAN NAGAR KOTA
Oral Test for Half Yearly Examination 2026-27
Class 6  |  Subject : English

A. TEXTBOOK — Lesson 1 to 7

1. (A Bottle of Dew) What does this lesson teach us?
Ans: It teaches that honest work, patience and effort are better than shortcuts to become rich.
2. (The Raven and the Fox) How did the fox trick the raven?
Ans: The fox flattered (praised) the raven, so the raven opened its beak and lost its food.
3. What is the moral of "The Raven and the Fox"?
Ans: We should not be misled by flattery; think carefully before acting.
4. (Rama to the Rescue) Which qualities does Rama show?
Ans: Rama shows quick thinking, helpfulness and responsible action in a difficult situation.
5. (The Unlikely Best Friends) Who were the unlikely best friends?
Ans: Owen, a baby hippo, and Mzee, an old tortoise.
6. What does this lesson teach about friendship?
Ans: Friendship can grow through kindness, trust and mutual care.
7. (A Friend's Prayer) What is the poem about?
Ans: It is a prayer-like poem about friendship, goodwill and being a caring friend.
8. (The Chair) What does the lesson encourage us to do?
Ans: It is a humorous story about an ordinary chair; it encourages us to observe and understand things carefully.
9. (Neem Baba) Why is the neem tree useful?
Ans: Neem is valuable in daily life, medicine and nature; the lesson shows traditional knowledge and responsible use of resources.

B. GRAMMAR

1. What is a Sentence?
Ans: A group of words that gives a complete meaning. It starts with a capital letter and ends with . ? or !
Ex: Kota is a beautiful city.
2. Name the kinds of Sentences.
Ans: (i) Assertive – She reads a book. (ii) Interrogative – Where do you live? (iii) Imperative – Open the door. (iv) Exclamatory – How lovely! (v) Optative – May you live long!
3. What are Articles? Fill in: ___ apple, ___ honest boy, ___ sun.
Ans: A, an, the are articles. An apple, an honest boy (silent h), the sun. Use "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before a consonant sound (a university).
4. What is a Noun? Name its kinds.
Ans: A noun is the name of a person, place, animal, thing or idea. Kinds: Proper (Kota), Common (boy), Collective (team), Material (gold), Abstract (honesty).
5. What are Auxiliaries and Modals? Give examples.
Ans: Auxiliaries (helping verbs) help the main verb: is, am, are, was, were, do, does, did, has, have, had. Modals show ability, permission, duty etc.: can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must. Ex: She can sing. May I come in? You must obey rules.
6. What is a Preposition? Fill in: The cat is ___ the bed. We sleep ___ night.
Ans: A word that shows the relation of a noun/pronoun with another word. under the bed; at night. (Others: in, on, by, with, between.)
7. What is a Conjunction? Fill in: I was tired ___ I slept early. Work hard ___ you will fail.
Ans: A word that joins words, phrases or sentences (and, but, or, so, because, if). so I slept early; work hard or you will fail.

C. APPLICATION — Transfer Certificate (T.C.)

To,
The Principal,

I beg to say that I am a student of Class VI in your school. My father has been transferred to Jaipur, so we are shifting there and I cannot continue my studies in your school. Kindly issue me the Transfer Certificate (T.C.) at the earliest. I shall be highly grateful to you.

Yours obediently,

🌿 Class 6 English Textbook — L-7 Neem Baba — Explanation & Worksheet
🌿 Neem Baba — Explanation

Central idea: The lesson presents the neem tree as a valuable part of nature and everyday life. It connects traditional knowledge with the many practical and environmental uses of neem. The chapter encourages learners to observe trees as living resources that support people and the environment. Current Class 6 Poorvi worksheets also focus on neem's environmental, agricultural and medicinal uses.

मुख्य बिंदु: ‘Neem Baba’ में नीम के पेड़ की उपयोगिता और प्रकृति के साथ हमारे संबंध पर ध्यान दिया गया है। नीम के विभिन्न भागों का पारंपरिक रूप से अनेक कामों में उपयोग किया जाता है और नीम का पेड़ पर्यावरण के लिए भी महत्त्वपूर्ण है।

Important Points
  • Neem seeds and neem-based preparations are discussed for their usefulness in protecting crops from harmful insects.
  • Neem is associated with traditional health and household practices.
  • The lesson promotes tree conservation, observation and respect for nature.
  • The chapter also uses activities to make students think about the benefits of trees in environmental, economic, social and health contexts.

  3. “Medicinal” means ___.

  4. The lesson encourages us to ___ useful trees.

🌶️ Class 6 English Textbook — L-9 Spices That Heal Us — Explanation & Worksheet
🌶️ Spices That Heal Us — Explanation

Central idea: The lesson is framed around traditional knowledge of common kitchen spices and their health-related uses. It introduces spices such as turmeric, fenugreek, cumin, asafoetida, cinnamon, clove, ginger, black pepper, fennel and cardamom, linking everyday food ingredients with traditional home remedies.

हिन्दी में संक्षिप्त समझ: इस पाठ में बताया गया है कि मसाले केवल भोजन का स्वाद और रंग बढ़ाने के लिए ही नहीं होते; कई मसालों के पारंपरिक रूप से स्वास्थ्य-संबंधी उपयोग भी बताए जाते हैं। दादी का पत्र बच्चों को रसोई में उपलब्ध मसालों के बारे में सीखने का अवसर देता है।

Important Points
  • Turmeric (haldi) is associated in the lesson with healing and anti-inflammatory/antiseptic properties.
  • Ginger is discussed in connection with digestion and relief from common cold/cough symptoms.
  • Clove is traditionally associated with relief from toothache.
  • Fenugreek (methi) is discussed in connection with digestion and traditional health practices.
  • The lesson values traditional knowledge while encouraging students to learn how common ingredients are used.

🕊️ National War Memorial — Explanation

Explanation: The National War Memorial in New Delhi honours the soldiers who gave their lives for the nation. The lesson teaches respect, gratitude and patriotism.

हिन्दी में समझ: नई दिल्ली का राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक देश के लिए बलिदान देने वाले सैनिकों को सम्मान देता है। पाठ सम्मान, कृतज्ञता और देशभक्ति सिखाता है।

Important Points
  • Memorial honours brave soldiers.
  • It is located in New Delhi.
  • We should show respect and gratitude.
📝 Worksheet — National War Memorial (20 Questions)
A. Answer the following questions (5)
  1. Where is the National War Memorial? — In New Delhi.
  2. Whom does it honour? — Soldiers who gave their lives for the nation.
  3. Make a sentence with sacrifice.
  4. Write five lines on our soldiers.
  5. How can we respect soldiers?
B. Tick the correct option (5)
  1. The National War Memorial is in ___.
    (a) New Delhi   (b) Mumbai   (c) Kota — Ans: (a) New Delhi
  2. It honours the ___ of the nation.
    (a) soldiers   (b) traders   (c) players — Ans: (a) soldiers
  3. We should show ___ to soldiers.
    (a) respect and gratitude   (b) anger   (c) fear — Ans: (a) respect and gratitude
  4. “Patriotism” means love for ___.
    (a) one’s country   (b) money   (c) games — Ans: (a) one’s country
  5. “Sacrifice” means ___.
    (a) giving up something for others   (b) winning   (c) resting — Ans: (a) giving up something for others
C. Fill in the blanks (5)
  1. The National War Memorial is in New ___. — Delhi
  2. It honours ___ who gave their lives. — soldiers
  3. We should show respect and ___. — gratitude
  4. ___ means love for one’s country. — Patriotism
  5. Soldiers made a great ___ for the nation. — sacrifice
D. True or False (5)
  1. The National War Memorial is in Mumbai. — False
  2. It honours soldiers. — True
  3. We should respect soldiers. — True
  4. Patriotism means hatred for one’s country. — False
  5. Soldiers sacrificed for the nation. — True
🔤 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-1 Sentence and its Kinds — Explanation & Worksheet
🔤 Sentence and its Kinds — Explanation

Explanation: A sentence is a group of words that gives a complete meaning. It starts with a capital letter and ends with . ? or !

हिन्दी में समझ: वाक्य शब्दों का ऐसा समूह है जो पूरा अर्थ देता है। Kinds: Assertive, Interrogative, Imperative, Exclamatory, Optative.

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Sentence and its Kinds
  1. Write the kind: “Open the door.” — Imperative
  2. Write the kind: “Where do you live?” — Interrogative
  3. Write the kind: “How lovely!” — Exclamatory
  4. Write the kind: “May you live long!” — Optative
  5. Write the kind: “She reads a book.” — Assertive
🏷️ Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-2 Noun — Explanation & Worksheet
🏷️ Noun — Explanation

Explanation: A noun is the name of a person, place, animal, thing or idea. Kinds: Proper (Kota), Common (boy), Collective (team), Material (gold), Abstract (honesty).

हिन्दी में समझ: संज्ञा किसी व्यक्ति, स्थान, जानवर, वस्तु या भाव का नाम है।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Noun
  1. Kind of noun: Kota — Proper
  2. Kind of noun: team — Collective
  3. Kind of noun: gold — Material
  4. Kind of noun: honesty — Abstract
  5. Kind of noun: boy — Common
👤 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-3 Pronoun — Explanation & Worksheet
👤 Pronoun — Explanation

Explanation: A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun. Examples: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.

हिन्दी में समझ: सर्वनाम संज्ञा की जगह आता है, जैसे I, you, he, she, it, we, they।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Pronoun
  1. Fill: Riya is kind. ___ helps everyone. — She
  2. Fill: The boys are playing. ___ are happy. — They
  3. Fill: Ram and I are friends. ___ study together. — We
  4. Fill: I have a pen. ___ is blue. — It
  5. Underline the pronoun: He reads daily. — He
🎨 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-4 Adjective — Explanation & Worksheet
🎨 Adjective — Explanation

Explanation: An adjective describes a noun or pronoun. Example: a tall boy, three books, red rose.

हिन्दी में समझ: विशेषण संज्ञा या सर्वनाम की विशेषता बताता है।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.

  1. Adjective in: a tall boy — tall
  2. Adjective in: three books — three
  3. Adjective in: a sweet mango — sweet
  4. Fill: The elephant is ___ animal. (big/bigly) — big

📎 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-5 Articles — Explanation & Worksheet
📎 Articles — Explanation

Explanation: A, an and the are articles. Use “an” before a vowel sound and “a” before a consonant sound. “The” is used for particular things.

हिन्दी में समझ: A, an, the आर्टिकल हैं। स्वर ध्वनि से पहले an और व्यंजन ध्वनि से पहले a लगता है।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Articles
  1. Fill: ___ apple — An
  2. Fill: ___ honest boy — An
  3. Fill: ___ university — A
  4. Fill: ___ sun rises in the east. — The
  5. Fill: He bought ___ umbrella. — an
🏃 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-6 Verb — Explanation & Worksheet
🏃 Verb — Explanation

Explanation: A verb shows an action, state or event. Examples: run, write, is, sleep.

हिन्दी में समझ: क्रिया काम, अवस्था या घटना बताती है।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Verb
  1. Verb in: Sita sings well. — sings
  2. Verb in: Birds fly. — fly
  3. Verb in: The dog barked. — barked
  4. Verb in: I am happy. — am
  5. Make a sentence with write.
🛠️ Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-7 Auxiliaries and Modals — Explanation & Worksheet
🛠️ Auxiliaries and Modals — Explanation

Explanation: Auxiliaries (helping verbs) help the main verb: is, am, are, was, were, do, does, did, has, have, had. Modals show ability, permission, duty: can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must.

हिन्दी में समझ: सहायक क्रिया मुख्य क्रिया की मदद करती है और Modals क्षमता, अनुमति, कर्तव्य आदि बताते हैं।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Auxiliaries and Modals
  1. Fill: She ___ swim well. (can/is) — can
  2. Fill: ___ I come in? (May/Is) — May
  3. Fill: You ___ obey your teachers. (should/are) — should
  4. Fill: They ___ playing. (are/can) — are
  5. Fill: He ___ finished his work. (has/may) — has

⏰ Tenses — Explanation

Explanation: Tense shows the time of an action: Present, Past and Future. Each has four forms: Simple, Continuous, Perfect and Perfect Continuous.

हिन्दी में समझ: काल क्रिया के समय को बताता है: Present, Past और Future।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Tenses
  1. Write past tense: play — played
  2. Change to past: She writes a letter. — She wrote a letter.
  3. Change to future: I eat mango. — I shall eat mango.
  4. Tense: They are singing. — Present Continuous
  5. Tense: He had gone. — Past Perfect
🤝 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-9 Subject–Verb Agreement — Explanation & Worksheet
🤝 Subject–Verb Agreement — Explanation

Explanation: The verb must agree with its subject in number. A singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural subject takes a plural verb.

हिन्दी में समझ: क्रिया को कर्ता के वचन के अनुसार होना चाहिए।

Important Points
  • Learn the rule and practise daily.
  • Check the examples carefully.
📝 Worksheet — Subject–Verb Agreement
  1. Choose: The boy ___ playing. (is/are) — is
  2. Choose: The boys ___ playing. (is/are) — are
  3. Choose: She ___ a book. (has/have) — has
  4. Choose: They ___ happy. (was/were) — were
  5. Choose: Each of the girls ___ honest. (is/are) — is
🟦 Class 6 English Grammar — Ch-14 Phrase and Clause — Explanation & Worksheet

📖 Explanation

Phrase (वाक्यांश): A phrase is a group of words that does not have a subject and a verb together. It gives only a part of the meaning.
Examples: in the garden, after lunch, a cup of tea, very quickly.
Clause (उपवाक्य): A clause is a group of words that has a subject and a verb.
Examples: the children played, when the bell rang, because it was late.
Independent clause (स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य) gives complete meaning and can stand alone as a sentence.
Example: She went home.
Dependent clause (आश्रित उपवाक्य) gives incomplete meaning. It depends on an independent clause and often begins with words like when, because, although, if, who.
Example: She went home because it was late.
हिन्दी में समझ: Phrase = शब्दों का ऐसा समूह जिसमें Subject और Verb का मेल नहीं होता। Clause = शब्दों का ऐसा समूह जिसमें Subject और Verb दोनों होते हैं।
⭐ Remember: Phrase = no subject-verb pair. Clause = has subject + verb.
📝 English Worksheet — Phrase and Clause
A. Tick the Correct Option
Q1. A group of words that has no subject-verb combination is called a —
(a) clause✅ (b) phrase(c) sentence(d) paragraph
Q2. Which of these is a clause?
(a) in the garden(b) after lunch✅ (c) when the bell rang(d) with a smile
Q3. A clause that gives complete meaning is called an —
✅ (a) independent clause(b) dependent clause(c) phrase(d) adjective
Q4. Which of these is a phrase?
(a) she sings(b) the sun rises✅ (c) under the old tree(d) because it rained
Q5. “Because it was late” is a —
(a) independent clause✅ (b) dependent clause(c) phrase(d) full stop
B. Fill in the Blanks
Q1. A phrase is a group of words that does not have a subject and a verb together.
Q2. A clause is a group of words that has a subject and a verb.
Q3. An independent clause can stand alone as a sentence.
Q4. A dependent clause cannot give complete meaning by itself.
Q5. “When the bell rang” is a dependent clause.
C. Underline the Correct Part
Q1. Underline the phrase: The children are playing in the garden.
Ans. The children are playing in the garden.
Q2. Underline the phrase: We will meet after lunch.
Ans. We will meet after lunch.
Q3. Underline the phrase: She sat under the old tree.
Ans. She sat under the old tree.
Q4. Underline the dependent clause: We stayed at home because it was raining.
Ans. We stayed at home because it was raining.
Q5. Underline the independent clause: I will call you when I reach home.
Ans. I will call you when I reach home.
D. Choose the Correct Option
Q1. “On the table” is a (phrase / clause).
Ans. phrase
Q2. “Because he was tired” is a (phrase / clause).
Ans. clause
Q3. “The sun rises in the east” is an (independent / dependent) clause.
Ans. independent
Q4. “Although it was cold” is a (independent / dependent) clause.
Ans. dependent
Q5. “Very quickly” is a (phrase / clause).
Ans. phrase
The End
